sloka: ब्रह्मर्षिमेवमुक्त्वा तु भरतं सबलानुगम् ।आज्ञापयामास तदा कुमारौ चाभ्यषेचयत् ।। ७.१००.१९ ॥
transliteration: brahmarṣimevamuktvā tu bharataṁ sabalānugam ।ājñāpayāmāsa tadā kumārau cābhyaṣecayat ।। 7.100.19 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to the Brahmarshi Vashistha, Rama then commanded Bharata, who was accompanied by his army and followers, and consecrated the two princes.
